verdict.rationale: Square documents a Payouts API that lists payouts filtered by location, status and time range. It also offers payment webhooks and an official MCP server through which an agent can reach Square APIs, so the payout-pull part of the story is covered first-party. The evidence shows no endpoint for listing transactions or payments and nothing about reconciling payouts against payments or exporting to a ledger, so the reconciliation would have to be built by the user's agent. Missing for 10: documented payments/transaction listing API, payout entry or fee breakdown for matching payouts to transactions, reconciliation or ledger/accounting export guidance, hands-on corroboration of an agent doing daily reconciliation.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull transactions and payouts via API and reconcile daily takings into my ledger
